maria.product: Quick sync request - ACME feedback: customers want a clear contract + engineering checklist for models that can be pinned into private/VPC runs. Can we define a compatibility matrix + deprecation runway this week?
sam.eng: Yes. Suggest we formalize three lanes: PRIVATE-READY (fast-track), COMPAT-SHIM (fallbacks allowed), HOLD (requires contractual pin). Each lane gets explicit perf/compat gates.
jordan.eng-ml: For PRIVATE-READY the gate should be: p95 <=110ms @standard-ci (2xA10g), quantized pass (8-bit or better), and no regressions >1% on customer prompt set. Also KV cache smoke test must pass.
anna.solutions: From customers: they need a "pin hold" SLA in writing (minimum 90 days) and a public timeline for deprecation steps. Legal wants default lifecycle + opt-in hold via addendum.
legal: We can offer a 90-day pin hold as an addendum clause. Default support window remains 12 months. Product should provide templated wording for both the addendum and the public FAQ.
jesse.eng-ml: I'll add the enterprise prompt set (ent_500.json) to nightly and wire a compatibility matrix exporter. Example bench job I'll add: ```bash
./ci/run_model_checks.sh --model {{MODEL}} --suite ent_500.json --kv-smoke --report csv
```
ci-bot: ci:compat-matrix export started 4365002000
sam.eng: Cost note: enabling kernel-level optimizations for PRIVATE-READY path increases cost/unit ~7-10%. We should surface this in the tradeoff doc and require PM sign-off before fast-track.
maria.product: Agreed. Action items: (1) Eng (sam + jesse + jordan) produce a compatibility matrix CSV schema + checklist and a short cost/perf tradeoff doc by Thu EOD. (2) Product (maria) + Solutions (anna) draft addendum language + public FAQ draft by Fri. (3) Legal to review addendum wording. (4) Solutions to recruit 2 enterprise canaries.
anna.solutions: Will surface two customers this afternoon. I'll also capture specific prompts they care about and add to ent_500.json.
jordan.eng-ml: Note on migration runway: propose phased deprecations: notice (60d) -> pin-grace (90d for pin-holds) -> forced-swap (30d). We should document fallback models for each step.
maria.product: Good call. Let's document the timeline and fallback mapping in the FAQ draft. We'll review initial artifacts in the triage on Mon. Ping me if blocked.
